name: CNCI Nagoya Center #1 (NGO1)
developer: Community Network Center Inc. / JPIX / AT TOKYO
notes: New Nagoya data center and connectivity hub announced by CNCI, JPIX and AT TOKYO; operations scheduled to commence in April 2027.

name: IIJ Moriyama Data Center
notes: IIJ announced its Moriyama Data Center in Nagoya, Aichi Prefecture would become operational on March 1, 2013; described as IIJ's second Tokai Region data center.

name: NTT Nagoya Daikancho
developer: NTT DATA / NTT Global Data Centers
notes: Directory sources list an operational NTT data center in Nagoya, Aichi; no public MW capacity found.

name: Akita 500MW AI Data Center project
developer: S2 Co. / bitgrit; prospective UAE funding including Mubadala reported
notes: Akita Prefecture/City plan reported as a large AI data center with up to 500 MW receiving capacity, led by Akita-based S2 and U.S. startup bitgrit, aiming for early-2030s operations; funding still prospective.

name: NTT Communications Akita Data Center
notes: Cloudscene lists an NTT Communications Akita Data Center in Japan's regional market; no public MW capacity found.

name: Aomori Cold Climate Extreme Data Center
developer: Blue Forest Data Solution Co., Ltd.
notes: Listed facility in Rokkasho, Aomori Prefecture, using cold-climate/outdoor-air and snow/ice cooling concepts; no public MW capacity found.

name: Google Inzai Data Center
notes: Google's official location page says it has called Inzai, Chiba home since 2023 and opened the Inzai data center in March 2023.

name: AirTrunk TOK1 Tokyo East
notes: AirTrunk describes TOK1 in Inzai's data center hub as Japan's largest hyperscale data center with 300+ MW total capacity across multiple buildings.

name: Digital Realty NRT14 at Inzai NRT Campus
notes: Digital Realty opened NRT14, the third facility at its Inzai NRT campus, in April 2026; trade press reports 31 MW and campus scale around/above 100 MW.

name: Colt Tokyo Inzai 4 Data Centre
notes: Colt DCS announced construction commencement for its fourth Inzai data center in Chiba Prefecture; designed capacity approximately 20 MW and 100% pre-let at announcement.

name: STACK TKY01 Inzai campus
notes: STACK says its two-building 36 MW campus is in Inzai; October 2025 financing release says the first 18 MW building will be delivered in 2026 with another 18 MW expansion capacity in 2027.

name: NTT DATA Tokyo TKY11 Data Center
developer: NTT DATA / NTT Global Data Centers
notes: Official NTT DATA page describes TKY11 in Shiroi City, Chiba, as a 50 MW two-building campus with first 24 MW IT-load building available in 2027 and a second 26 MW building to follow.

name: NTT DATA Tokyo TKY12 Campus
developer: NTT DATA / NTT Global Data Centers
notes: Reported six-building hyperscale campus in the Inzai-Shiroi area of Chiba Prefecture, planned for about 200 MW total IT capacity; first phase expected around 2030.

name: STNet Matsuyama Data Center
notes: Data Center Map lists STNet's Matsuyama Data Center in Ehime Prefecture with seismic isolation and disaster-resilience features; no public MW capacity found.

name: OPTAGE Container-Type AI Data Center Mihama
developer: OPTAGE Inc. / Kansai Electric Power Group
notes: OPTAGE announced a container-type generative AI data center in Mihama-cho, Fukui Prefecture, to start operation within FY2026, using dedicated liquid-cooled GPU infrastructure and 100% CO2-free nuclear-derived power.

name: IDC Frontier Fukuoka Kitakyushu Data Center (Asian Frontier)
notes: IDC Frontier official page describes the Fukuoka Kitakyushu Data Center in Kitakyushu, Fukuoka as one of Western Japan's largest data centers, with multiple buildings and expandable site/power.

name: QTnet Fukuoka Data Center 3 (QD3)
notes: QTnet official page lists QD3 in Fukuoka City, opened September 2019, with about 10,000 sq m floor area, about 1,400 racks, seismic isolation and up to 30 kVA/rack.

name: AT TOKYO Kyushu Center #1 (QC1) at QD3
notes: AT TOKYO established Kyushu Center #1 within QTnet's Fukuoka Data Center 3, with operations planned from November 2021; AT TOKYO says it operates 13 data centers including Fukuoka.

name: TELEHOUSE Fukuoka
notes: TELEHOUSE/KDDI Japan network includes Fukuoka; directory source lists TELEHOUSE Fukuoka in Hakataekihigashi, Fukuoka.

name: IDC Frontier Fukushima Shirakawa Data Center
notes: IDC Frontier official page says Fukushima Shirakawa Data Center operates in Shirakawa City, Fukushima Prefecture, using outdoor-air and water-cooled air conditioning and modular expansion.

name: Densan System Ogaki IDC
notes: Densan System official IDC page describes Ogaki IDC in Gifu Prefecture with seismic-isolated structure, dual utility feeds, generator backup, 24/365 operations and multi-layer security.

name: Densan System Tono Internet Data Center
notes: JDCC data center list identifies Tono Internet Data Center in Toki City, Gifu Prefecture, operated by Densan System, opened 2013 and tier 3 equivalent.

name: Gifu school network data center rebuild/operations procurement
notes: Gifu Prefecture issued a public notice inviting comments on specifications for rebuilding and operating/maintaining the school interconnection network data center; public-sector IT facility, not hyperscale colocation.

name: Fujitsu Tatebayashi Data Center Annex C
notes: Fujitsu announced Annex C at its Tatebayashi Data Center in Gunma Prefecture opened and commenced operations on April 5, 2016; later Fujitsu materials identify Tatebayashi as a top-tier domestic data center.

name: Ryomo Systems New Data Center / Ota DC
notes: Ryomo Systems official special site says a sustainable data center opens in Gunma, about two hours from central Tokyo; Data Center Map lists Ryomo Systems Ota DC in Ota City, Gunma, and Nikken Sekkei CM lists a Ryomo Systems New Data Center project in Gunma.
